name: Eleanor Harlenay
source:
Eleanor Harlenay is the innkeeper of the B-and-B in Birchport. She makes her first appearance in Chapter 1.

Eleanor is shown to be helpful and giving, as she constantly offers her own outfits to [url=/c134994/]Your Character[/url]. Eleanor is also blunt, the major example of which being when she tries to tell stories about her romantic experiences with various ex-spouses and ex-partners [spoiler](and later with her fiancée Samantha Winters)[/spoiler] until Your Character stops her. She also finds all of Your Character's suitors attractive and says that if she was younger, she would pursue them herself.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Eleanor_Harlenay]Wiki[/url]]
